status.description: Status is the current status of the ClusterConfig.

ClusterConfig.title: Cluster Config
ClusterConfig.description: ClusterConfig is the sole source of truth for all the global configurations and settings of the Cordium Cluster. It controls the Space ownership policy, the Workspace storage class selection, the Cluster-wide resource limits as well as the Workspace timeouts. There is exactly one ClusterConfig per Cordium Cluster. It is created automatically at installation time and it is managed by the Cluster administrators via the ManagementService.

space.description: Space is the Cluster-wide Space-related configuration.

workspace.description: Workspace is the Cluster-wide Workspace-related configuration.

volume.description: Volume is the Cluster-wide Volume-related configuration.

ownership.description: Ownership is the policy that controls which Users are allowed to own Spaces. If it is unset, no User is allowed to own a Space.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.ClusterConf.title: Space
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.ClusterConf.description: Space is the Cluster-wide Space-related configuration.

rules.description: Rules is the list of the ownership rules. The DENY rules are evaluated first and, if none of them matches, the ALLOW rules are evaluated. If no rule matches, the request is denied.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.ClusterConf.title: Ownership
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.ClusterConf.description: Ownership is the policy that controls which Users are allowed to own (i.e. create) Spaces.

effect.title: Effect
effect.description: Effect is the effect of the Rule when its Condition matches

condition.description: Condition is evaluated against the request context which contains the requesting User (i.e. `ctx.user`) and the Space that is being created (i.e. `ctx.space`).

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.ClusterConf.title: Rule
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.ClusterConf.description: Rule is a single ownership rule.

storage.description: Storage is the storage provisioning configuration of the Volumes.

limit.description: Limit is the Cluster-wide Volume limits.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.ClusterConf.title: Volume
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.ClusterConf.description: Volume is the Cluster-wide Volume-related configuration.

maxPerSpace.description: MaxPerSpace is the maximum total number of the Volumes that a single Space can own.

maxSize.description: MaxSize is a hard cap that no Volume of the Cluster can exceed.

defaultSize.description: DefaultSize is the size of the Volumes that do not request an explicit one.

maxMountsPerWorkspace.description: MaxMountsPerWorkspace is the maximum number of the Volumes that a single Workspace can mount.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.ClusterConf.title: Limit
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.ClusterConf.description: Limit is the Cluster-wide Volume limits. All the fields are optional and omitting one means that no Cluster-level restriction is applied for that dimension.

storageClass.description: StorageClass selects the StorageClass of the Volumes. If it is unset or if no rule matches, the Cluster lets Kubernetes pick its default StorageClass instead.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.ClusterConf.title: Storage
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.ClusterConf.description: Storage is the storage provisioning configuration of the Volumes.

rules.description: Rules is the list of the storage class selection rules. They are evaluated in order and the first matching one is used.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.ClusterConf.title: Storage Class
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.ClusterConf.description: StorageClass selects the Kubernetes StorageClass that is used to provision the Volumes. Since the Kubernetes API does not expose whether a StorageClass is able to provide multi-writer volumes, the rules are what tells the Cluster which backend to use for the SHARED Volumes and which one to use for the EXCLUSIVE ones.

condition.description: Condition is evaluated against the request context which contains the Volume that is being provisioned (i.e. `ctx.volume`).

storageClass.description: StorageClass is the name of the Kubernetes StorageClass that is used once the Condition matches.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.ClusterConf.title: Rule
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.ClusterConf.description: Rule is a single storage class selection rule.

storage.description: Storage is the storage provisioning configuration of the Workspaces.

limit.description: Limit is the Cluster-wide Workspace limits.

timeout.description: Timeout is the Cluster-wide Workspace inactivity timeouts.

runtime.description: Runtime is the Cluster-wide runtime configuration of the Workspaces.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.ClusterConf.title: Workspace
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.ClusterConf.description: Workspace is the Cluster-wide Workspace-related configuration.

maxPerUser.description: MaxPerUser is the maximum total number of the Workspaces that a single User can own.

maxActivePerUser.description: MaxActivePerUser is the maximum number of the Workspaces that a single User can have running at the same time.

buildLimit.description: BuildLimit is the compute resources that are allocated for the Template pre-build Workspaces.

defaultOrganizationSpaceLimit.description: DefaultOrganizationSpaceLimit is the default compute resources of the Workspaces that belong to ORGANIZATION Spaces.

defaultUserSpaceLimit.description: DefaultUserSpaceLimit is the default compute resources of the Workspaces that belong to USER Spaces.

maxLimit.description: MaxLimit is a hard cap that no Workspace of the Cluster can exceed.

maxSnapshotsPerUser.description: MaxSnapshotsPerUser is the maximum total number of the WorkspaceSnapshots that a single User can own.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.ClusterConf.title: Limit
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.ClusterConf.description: Limit is the Cluster-wide Workspace limits. All the fields are optional and omitting one means that no Cluster-level restriction is applied for that dimension.

capabilities.description: Capabilities is the Linux capabilities that are merged into every Workspace of the Cluster.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.ClusterConf.title: Runtime
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.ClusterConf.description: Runtime is the Cluster-wide runtime configuration of the Workspaces.

storageClass.description: StorageClass selects the StorageClass of the Workspaces' volumes.

volumeSnapshotClass.description: VolumeSnapshotClass selects the VolumeSnapshotClass of the Template pre-build snapshots and of the WorkspaceSnapshots. If it is unset or if no rule matches, the Cluster lets Kubernetes pick the default VolumeSnapshotClass of the volume's CSI driver instead.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.ClusterConf.title: Storage
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.ClusterConf.description: Storage is the storage provisioning configuration of the Workspaces.

rules.description: Rules is the list of the storage class selection rules. They are evaluated in order and the first matching one is used.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.ClusterConf.title: Storage Class
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.ClusterConf.description: StorageClass selects the Kubernetes StorageClass that is used to provision the Workspaces' volumes.

condition.description: Condition is evaluated against the Workspace that is being provisioned (i.e. `workspace`).

storageClass.description: StorageClass is the name of the Kubernetes StorageClass that is used once the Condition matches.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.ClusterConf.title: Rule
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.ClusterConf.description: Rule is a single storage class selection rule.

rules.description: Rules is the list of the volume snapshot class selection rules. They are evaluated in order and the first matching one is used.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.ClusterConf.title: Volume Snapshot Class
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.ClusterConf.description: VolumeSnapshotClass selects the Kubernetes VolumeSnapshotClass that is used for the Template pre-build snapshots as well as for the WorkspaceSnapshots.

condition.description: Condition is evaluated against the request context which contains the snapshotted Workspace (i.e. `ctx.workspace`) and its Template (i.e. `ctx.template`).

volumeSnapshotClass.description: VolumeSnapshotClass is the name of the Kubernetes VolumeSnapshotClass that is used once the Condition matches.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.ClusterConf.title: Rule
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.ClusterConf.description: Rule is a single volume snapshot class selection rule.

defaultDuration.description: DefaultDuration is the inactivity timeout that is applied when no Space-type-specific duration is set.

userSpaceDuration.description: UserSpaceDuration is the inactivity timeout of the Workspaces that belong to USER Spaces.

organizationSpaceDuration.description: OrganizationSpaceDuration is the inactivity timeout of the Workspaces that belong to ORGANIZATION Spaces.

maxActiveDuration.description: MaxActiveDuration is the maximum total duration for which a Workspace can remain running regardless of its activity.

allowNoTimeout.description: AllowNoTimeout allows the Workspaces to disable their inactivity timeout entirely via their runtime's timeout mode.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.ClusterConf.title: Timeout
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.ClusterConf.description: Timeout is the Cluster-wide inactivity timeouts after which a running Workspace is automatically stopped. All the fields are optional.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.ClusterConf.title: Status
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.ClusterConf.description: Status is the current status of the ClusterConfig. It is intentionally empty.

match.description: Match contains a single CEL expression

all.description: All acts as a logical AND operator on its list of CEL expressions

any.description: Any acts as a logical OR operator on its list of CEL expressions

not.description: Not acts as a logical NOT operator of a single CEL expression

none.description: None acts as a logical NOR operator on its list of CEL expressions (i.e. none of the expressions matches)

opa.description: OPA contains an OPA (Open Policy Agent) Rego script

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Condition.title: Condition
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Condition.description: Condition is a boolean expression that is evaluated by the Cluster against a request context. It is used by the ClusterConfig rules (e.g. the Space ownership rules and the storage class selection rules).

of.description: Of is the list of the Conditions that all have to match.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Condition.A.title: All
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Condition.A.description: All acts as a logical AND operator on its list of Conditions.

of.description: Of is the list of the Conditions of which at least one has to match.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Condition.A.title: Any
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Condition.A.description: Any acts as a logical OR operator on its list of Conditions.

of.description: Of is the list of the Conditions of which none is allowed to match.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Condition.N.title: None
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Condition.N.description: None acts as a logical NOR operator on its list of Conditions.

inline.description: Inline is the OPA Rego script directly provided as a string

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Condition.O.title: OPA
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Condition.O.description: OPA is an OPA (Open Policy Agent) Rego script.

megabytes.description: Megabytes is the capacity in megabytes.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Volume.Spec.title: Size
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Volume.Spec.description: Size is the capacity of a Volume.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.title: Limit
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.description: Limit is the compute resources that are allocated for the Workspace. The effective limits are resolved by precedence (i.e. Workspace, Template, Space default and then the Cluster default) and are then capped by the Space and the Cluster maximums.

millicores.description: Millicores is the number of CPU millicores (i.e. 1 core equals 1000 millicores).

megabytes.description: Megabytes is the amount of memory in megabytes.
Megabytes is the amount of disk storage in megabytes.

add.description: Add is the list of the Linux capabilities that are added (e.g. `NET_ADMIN`).

drop.description: Drop is the list of the Linux capabilities that are dropped (e.g. `NET_RAW`).

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.title: Capabilities
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.description: Capabilities is the Linux capabilities of the Workspace's container. It is merged with the Space-level and the ClusterConfig-level capabilities.

milliseconds.description: Milliseconds is the duration set in milliseconds

seconds.description: Seconds is the duration set in seconds

minutes.description: Minutes is the duration set in minutes

hours.description: Hours is the duration set in hours

days.description: Days is the duration set in days

weeks.description: Weeks is the duration set in weeks

months.description: Months is the duration set in months

octelium.api.main.meta.v1.Duration.title: Duration
octelium.api.main.meta.v1.Duration.description: Duration is a length of time that is expressed in a single unit of choice. Exactly one of the units is set (e.g. `seconds: 30`).

uid.description: UID is the unique UUID value for the object assigned by the Cluster. Read-only.

name.description: Name is the name of the object. It must be unique within a certain API/Version/Kind tuple.

createdAt.description: CreatedAt is the timestamp of creation of the object. Read-only.

updatedAt.description: UpdatedAt is the timestamp of when the object was last updated. Read-only.

displayName.description: DisplayName is the name that can be shown publicly for the object. Doesn't need to be unique.

description.description: Description is used to describe the object in a short sentence. Maximum characters are 1000.

labels.description: Labels is a map of string keys and values to organize objects.

tags.description: Tags is an optional array of tags that classify the Resource.

annotations.description: Annotations is a map of string keys and values that can be used to store arbitrary metadata about the object.

picURL.description: PicURL is the Picture URL of the resource.

resourceVersion.description: ResourceVersion is a unique ID that represent the current version of the resource object. Used by the Cluster to detect updates.

lastResourceVersion.description: LastResourceVersion is the ResourceVersion of the last update of the Resource.

actorRef.description: ActorRef is the object reference to the Actor resource, typically a Session, who is responsible for the current resource change. If ActorRef is not set, then the current change of the resource was done by the Cluster

actorOperation.description: ActorOperation is the gRPC full method triggered by the actorRef to modify the Resource

isSystem.description: IsSystem means that the resource is created by the Cluster and it cannot be managed by the administrators. Read-only.

specLabels.description: SpecLabels is map used internally by the Cluster for quick searches among lists of objects. Read-only.

isUserHidden.description: IsUserHidden means that the resource object is hidden from ordinary Users and should not be exposed via the User APIs.

isSystemHidden.description: IsSystemHidden means that the resource object is hidden by the Cluster and should not be exposed via the APIs.

systemLabels.description: SystemLabels is a similar map to specLabels. Used only by the Cluster.

octelium.api.main.meta.v1.Metadata.title: Metadata
octelium.api.main.meta.v1.Metadata.description: Metadata is the metadata that is common to every Cluster resource. It carries the resource's identity (i.e. its UID and name), its human-readable information as well as the Cluster-managed bookkeeping of the resource's versioning and provenance.

apiVersion.description: APIVersion is the API version of the reference resource

kind.description: Kind is the resource kind. A kind is unique per an APIVersion.

uid.description: UID is the resource object UID. A UID is unique across the entire Cluster.

name.description: Name is the resource object name. A name is unique per a certain kind.

resourceVersion.description: ResourceVersion is the resourceVersion of the resource.

octelium.api.main.meta.v1.ObjectReferenc.title: Object Reference
octelium.api.main.meta.v1.ObjectReferenc.description: ObjectReference is a reference to another Cluster resource. It identifies the referenced resource by its kind and either its UID or its name.
